# hiok_vnet_peering (Resource)

Peering between two virtual networks.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `local_vnet_name` (String)
- `remote_vnet_name` (String)
- `vnet_id` (String) The local virtual network's id.

### Optional

- `allow_local_to_remote` (Boolean)
- `allow_remote_to_local` (Boolean)
- `enable_gateway_transit` (Boolean)
- `enable_nat` (Boolean)
- `peering_type` (String) local, cross-host or cross-region.
